name: 夕阳再现·风云再起Ⅱ
english_name: Sunset Reappears: Storm Rises Again II
english_description: The site's subtitle is "Storm Rises Again II" (domain www.zhaoshu.net). Players start as a commoner youth landing in one of several randomly-assigned jianghu towns/outposts (North Frontier Town, Iron Spear Temple, and others), openly permits player-vs-player combat, and requires setting two independent passwords (a recovery "admin password" plus the everyday login password) at registration. It belongs to the same Sunset Reappears family of wuxia MUD engines as this project's xyzxfk (Crazy Jianghu), and the relationship is much closer than "shared engine": a full file-level comparison of their common world files found roughly 97% byte-for-byte identical (including the shared d/city/sj.lpc), with each side layering only small independent tweaks (e.g. xyzxfk's extra guild-teleport command) on top of the same authored map — best understood as two parallel-maintained snapshots of one world rather than two fully separate games, even though each has its own distinct login/security code. This branch's map lineage (also shared with xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412) is a different family from another cluster of similarly-branded archives in this collection whose maps actually belong to an unrelated "Tianya" family.
